_comment: WOAH-04 Resonanzfeld — sound inventory. ZERO new sound events shipped: assets/eclipse/sounds.json + registry/EclipseSounds.java are locked by the parallel wave, so every beat is layered LIVE in code from vanilla events + one shipped eclipse event (the plan-§6 recipes, mixed at play-time instead of in a sounds.json row). Senders: woah/resonance/ResonanceMelodyMachine + ResonanceFieldService (server), woah/resonance/client/ResonanceChoir (client-local voices). If the main agent later wants the plan's dedicated rows, the intended definitions are under 'deferred_sounds_json_rows'.

reused_vanilla_events.minecraft:block.note_block.bell: THE crystal note voice (plan §6.1): every strike/teach/cascade/arpeggio note plays this at the ResonanceTones pentatonic pitch table ({-12,-10,-8,-5,-3,0,+2,+4,+7} semitones -> 2^(n/12)). 1.21.1 Mojang-mappings gotcha handled: SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BELL is a Holder<SoundEvent>, so ResonanceMelodyMachine.playCrystalNote uses the Holder overload of Level.playSound on purpose.
reused_vanilla_events.minecraft:block.amethyst_block.chime: Glassy shimmer layered UNDER every bell note (same pitch, x0.6 volume) — the two-layer 'crystal' timbre; also a Holder-typed constant.
reused_vanilla_events.minecraft:block.amethyst_cluster.hit: The physical 'tap' transient on the struck crystal itself (ResonanceFieldService.strike, pitch ~ tone).
reused_vanilla_events.minecraft:block.amethyst_block.resonate: TEACH intro swell at the altar + the finale's rising resonance bed.
reused_vanilla_events.minecraft:block.amethyst_block.break: FAIL sting bottom layer (pitch 0.6) — the 'crystal cracks' read.
reused_vanilla_events.minecraft:block.note_block.didgeridoo: FAIL dissonance dyad: two didgeridoo notes a tritone apart (pitch 0.53/0.75) — deliberately NOT from the pentatonic table.
reused_vanilla_events.minecraft:block.bell.resonate: Finale crown layer (long golden after-ring over the arpeggio flood).

reused_eclipse_events.eclipse:event.emerge: Finale reward beat when the shard drops (pitch 1.2) — the house 'something arrives' whoosh.
reused_eclipse_events.eclipse:ambient.limbo_loop: ResonanceChoir voice FALLBACK ONLY: until the dedicated ambient.crystal_voice .ogg is delivered, each idle crystal voice is this loop re-pitched by the SAME ResonanceTones table at low volume — exactly the documented self-healing fallback from SanctumHum.resolveHum(). The choir resolves eclipse:ambient.crystal_voice from the registry first and uses it automatically the moment the row lands.

deferred_sounds_json_rows.ambient.crystal_voice: { "category": "ambient", "subtitle": "subtitles.eclipse.ambient.crystal_voice", "sounds": [ { "name": "eclipse:ambient/crystal_voice", "stream": false } ] } — a soft glass-bow drone tone, loopable, ~6 s, recorded at tone index 5 (pitch 1.0 = A4) so the ResonanceTones pitch table transposes it correctly. Registry side: EclipseSounds.AMBIENT_CRYSTAL_VOICE = register("ambient.crystal_voice"). Consumed by woah/resonance/client/ResonanceChoir.resolveVoice() which already looks the id up dynamically — NO code change needed when the row + .ogg land.

subtitles_note: subtitles.eclipse.ambient.crystal_voice ('Crystal sings' / 'Kristall singt') is already staged in docs/plans_v3/langdrop/woah_resonance.json so it ships together with the langdrop merge; all layered vanilla/eclipse events reuse their existing subtitles.
